Name: Fruit Spouses
Author: Acc9000
Description:
Actually, because [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40040]this[/url] exists. 

Thank you [s]Oclarina[/s] Apricot for [s]making me suffer[/s] getting me to learn how to make compats.
Thank you, me, for making stuff overcomplicated for myself again.
But I prevailed.. by some miracle and mainly by help in the mod making thread <3 thank you, lovely people, who have endless patience with me - Aba, chu, Selph, Husky.

SO!
Based on popular demand, there is Elliott with 2 versions of fruit: Sweet Gem Berry, which matches his hair better, and Apricot, because Oclarina loves Apricot Elliott. Otherwise Apricot fits Sam better. Choose your favourite version of Elliott in the Config menu!

ALSO!
If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40040]Big Apricot[/url]﻿ by oclarina installed, there will be a big apricot with Elliott's and Sam's portraits! Check it out! Even the descriptions change! Woohoo!


Ok i'll see myself out.

Have fun decorating :)



P.S.: Yeah i know a void egg is not fruit but there is no black fruit and Krobus is special anyway so deal with it. Chicken fruit.
